property_summary: Invariant: Only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership, so after any call to transferOwnership by an address A the owner becomes A iff A was the pre-call owner; the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners to call transferOwnership and thus can change owner when a non-owner calls it, violating the invariant.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so it requires msg.sender != owner, allowing only non-owners to execute guarded functions and changing who can call transferOwnership.
